newsitem.title: USA: Arrests at Chrysler Fenton, Mo. plant - police.
newsitem.headline: Arrests at Chrysler Fenton, Mo. plant - police.

text.p: Police raided a Chrysler Corp plant in Fenton, Missouri, arresting at least 16 employees on charges related to gambling and drugs, St. Louis County police said on Friday.
The company said in a statement 29 people were arrested.

Warrants were issued after an 18-month surveillance operation into gambling and drug-related activities within the plant, police said. The assembly plant, which has been idled due to a shortage of engines caused by a union strike at the company, makes Dodge Ram pickup trucks.
Chrysler Corp said that 29 people were arrested, 26 of which were employeees at the St. Louis facility.
